Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I begin praising You with Your praise
And You guide to that which is right by Your grace
And I am certain that You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy
In the position of pardon and mercy
And the Harshest of punishers
In the position of punishment and vengeance
And the Greatest of those who display power
In the position of pride and magnificence

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَذِنْتَ لِيْ فِيْ دُعَائِكَ وَمَسْأَلَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, You have permitted me to supplicate to You and ask of You
So hear, O All-Hearing, my praise
And answer, O Merciful, my call
And overlook, O Forgiving, my mistake

Arabic text: فَكَمْ يَا إِلٰهِيْ مِنْ كُرْبَةٍ قَدْ فَرَّجْتَهَا
Translation: For how many, O my God, a worry You have relieved
And sorrows You have dispelled
And errors You have overlooked
And mercy You have spread
And chains of hardship You have broken

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
Translation: All praise is for Allah who has not taken a wife or a son

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِيْ الْمُلْكِ
Translation: And who has no partner in dominion

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ
Translation: And who has no protector out of weakness
And magnify Him with a great magnification
All praise is for Allah with all His praises
For all His blessings

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَا مُضَادَّ لَهُ فِيْ مُلْكِهِ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who has no opponent in His kingdom
And no challenger in His command

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ فِيْ خَلْقِهِ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who has no partner in His creation
And no equal in His greatness

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الْفَاشِيْ فِيْ الْخَلْقِ أَمْرُهُ وَحَمْدُهُ
Translation: All praise is for Allah whose command and praise pervade the creation
Whose glory is apparent through His generosity
Who extends His hand with bounty
Whose treasuries never diminish

Arabic text: وَلَا تَزِيدُهُ كَثْرَةُ الْعَطَاءِ إِلَّا جُودًا وَكَرَمًا
Translation: And excessive giving only increases His generosity and nobility
Indeed, He is the Mighty, the Bestower

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ قَلِيْلًا مِنْ كَثِيرٍ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for a little from much
While I am in great need of it
And You have always been independent of it
While to me it is great
And to You it is easy and simple
O Allah, indeed Your forgiveness of my sin
And Your overlooking my mistake
And Your pardoning my wrongdoing
And Your concealing my ugly deeds
And Your forbearance regarding my many crimes

Arabic text: عِنْدَ مَا كَانَ مِنْ خَطَإِيْ وَعَمْدِي
Translation: When I committed them by error or deliberately

Arabic text: أَطْمَعَنِيْ فِيْ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَا أَسْتَوْجِبُهُ مِنْكَ
Translation: Has encouraged me to ask You for what I do not deserve from You
That which You have provided me from Your mercy
And shown me from Your power
And made known to me from Your response
So I began to call upon You, feeling secure
And ask You, feeling familiar
Neither afraid nor fearful

Arabic text: مُدِلًّا عَلَيْكَ فِيمَا قَصَدْتُ فِيْهِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Relying on You in what I purpose from You

Arabic text: فَإِنْ أَبْطَأَ عَنِّيْ عَتَبْتُ بِجَهْلِيْ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: Then if there is a delay, I reproach You out of my ignorance

Arabic text: وَلَعَلَّ الَّذِيْ أَبْطَأَ عَنِّيْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لِي
Translation: Yet perhaps what has been delayed for me is better for me
Due to Your knowledge of the outcome of matters
So I have never seen a more generous master

Arabic text: أَصْبَرَ عَلَى عَبْدٍ لَئِيمٍ مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: More patient with a worthless servant than You are with me

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ إِنَّكَ تَدْعُونِيْ فَأُوَلِّيْ عَنْكَ
Translation: O Lord, You call me and I turn away from You
You show affection to me and I show dislike to You
You express love to me but I do not accept from You
As if I have a claim of benevolence upon You

Arabic text: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ ذٰلِكَ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ لِي
Translation: Yet this did not prevent You from having mercy on me
And being good to me
And favoring me with Your generosity and nobility
So have mercy on Your ignorant servant
And bestow upon him with the grace of Your goodness
Indeed, You are Generous and Noble
All praise is for Allah, Master of the kingdom
Controller of the ships
Subjugator of the winds
Cleaver of the dawn
Judge of the Day of Judgment
Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى حِلْمِهِ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهِ
Translation: All praise is for Allah for His forbearance despite His knowledge

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى عَفْوِهِ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِهِ
Translation: And praise is for Allah for His forgiveness despite His power

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى طُولِ أَنَاتِهِ فِيْ غَضَبِهِ
Translation: And praise is for Allah for His patience in His anger
Though He has the power to do as He wills
All praise is for Allah, Creator of creation
Extender of sustenance
Cleaver of the dawn
Possessor of Glory and Honor
Grace and Blessing
Who is so far that He cannot be seen
Yet so near that He witnesses all secret conversations
Blessed and Exalted is He

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ لَهُ مُنَازِعٌ يُعَادِلُهُ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who has no rival to oppose Him
No equal to resemble Him
No helper to assist Him
He overpowered the mighty with His might
And the great humble themselves before His greatness
So He accomplishes with His power whatever He wills

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ يُجِيبُنِيْ حِيْنَ أُنَادِيهِ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who answers me when I call Him

Arabic text: وَيَسْتُرُ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ عَوْرَةٍ وَأَنَا أَعْصِيهِ
Translation: And conceals all my faults even as I disobey Him
And increases His favors upon me when I do not repay Him

Arabic text: فَكَمْ مِنْ مَوْهِبَةٍ هَنِيئَةٍ قَدْ أَعْطَانِي
Translation: How many pleasant gifts He has given me
And great terrors He has saved me from
And joyful delights He has shown me
So I praise Him with gratitude
And remember Him with glorification

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُهْتَكُ حِجَابُهُ
Translation: All praise is for Allah whose veil cannot be pierced
Whose door is never closed
Whose seeker is never rejected
Whose hopeful is never disappointed
All praise is for Allah who secures the frightened
And saves the righteous
And raises the oppressed
And debases the arrogant
And destroys kings and replaces them with others
All praise is for Allah, Crusher of tyrants
Destroyer of the unjust
Overtaker of those who flee
Punisher of oppressors
Helper of those who cry for help
The place for the needs of the seekers
The reliance of the believers

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ مِنْ خَشْيَتِهِ تَرْعَدُ السَّمَاءُ وَسُكَّانُهَا
Translation: All praise is for Allah, from fear of whom the heaven and its inhabitants tremble
And the earth and its dwellers shake

Arabic text: وَتَمُوجُ الْبِحَارُ وَمَنْ يَسْبَحُ فِيْ غَمَرَاتِهَا
Translation: And the seas and those who swim in their depths surge
All praise is for Allah who has guided us to this

Arabic text: وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلَا أَنْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ
Translation: And we would not have been guided had Allah not guided us

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ يَخْلُقُ وَلَمْ يُخْلَقْ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who creates but is not created
Who provides but is not provided for
Who feeds but is not fed
Who causes the living to die
And brings the dead to life
And He is the Living who never dies
In His hand is all good
And He has power over all things

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and messenger
And Your trustee and chosen one and Your beloved
And the best of Your creation
And the guardian of Your secret
And the deliverer of Your messages
The most excellent, most beautiful, most elegant
Most perfect, most pure, most prosperous
Most pleasant, most clean, most sublime
And most abundant of the blessings You have bestowed
And mercy and kindness You have shown

Arabic text: وَسَلَّمْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ
Translation: And peace You have granted to any of Your servants, prophets
Messengers and chosen ones
And those honored by You from Your creation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings on Ali, the Commander of the Faithful
And the successor of the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds
Your servant and guardian and the brother of Your Messenger
And Your proof over Your creation
And Your greatest sign
And the great news
And send blessings on the truthful, pure one
Fatima, the leader of the women of the worlds
And send blessings on the two grandsons of Mercy
And the two Imams of guidance
Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn
The two leaders of the youth of Paradise
And send blessings on the Imams of the Muslims
Ali ibn Al-Husayn
And Muhammad ibn Ali
And Ja'far ibn Muhammad
And Musa ibn Ja'far
And Ali ibn Musa
And Muhammad ibn Ali
And Ali ibn Muhammad
And al-Hasan ibn Ali
And the successor, the guide, the awaited one
Your proofs over Your servants
And Your trustees in Your lands
Plentiful and continuous blessings
O Allah, send blessings on the guardian of Your command
The one who will rise, the awaited one
And the expected justice
And surround him with Your favored angels
And support him with the Holy Spirit
O Lord of the Worlds
O Allah, make him the caller to Your Book
And the establisher of Your religion
Make him Your successor on earth
As You made those before him successors

Arabic text: مَكِّنْ لَهُ دِيْنَهُ الَّذِيْ ارْتَضَيْتَهُ لَهُ
Translation: Establish for him his religion which You have approved for him
Change his fear into security
He will worship You and not associate anything with You
O Allah, honor him and be honored through him
Help him and be helped through him
And help him with a mighty help
And grant him an easy victory

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا
Translation: And provide him from Yourself with a supporting authority

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَظْهِرْ بِهِ دِيْنَكَ وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: O Allah, manifest through him Your religion and the way of Your Prophet

Arabic text: حَتَّىٰ لَا يَسْتَخْفِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
Translation: Until nothing of the truth remains hidden
Out of fear of any of the creation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ دَوْلَةٍ كَرِيمَةٍ
Translation: O Allah, we ask You for a noble government
Through which You honor Islam and its followers
And humiliate hypocrisy and its adherents

Arabic text: وَتَجْعَلُنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الدُّعَاةِ إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And make us in it among those who invite to Your obedience
And leaders to Your path
And grant us through it the honor of this world and the Hereafter

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا عَرَّفْتَنَا مِنَ الْحَقِّ فَحَمِّلْنَاهُ
Translation: O Allah, what You have made known to us of the truth, help us bear it
And what we fall short of, help us attain it
O Allah, through him, bring together our disunity
And mend our divisions
And repair our rifts
And multiply our small numbers
And strengthen us after our humiliation
And enrich our poverty
And lift our debts
And relieve our distress
And fill our gaps
And ease our difficulties
And brighten our faces
And free our captives
And grant success to our requests
And fulfill our promises
And answer our prayers
And grant us our wishes

Arabic text: وَبَلِّغْنَا بِهِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ آمَالَنَا
Translation: And let us attain our hopes in this world and the Hereafter
And give us more than we desire
O Best of those who are asked
And Most Generous of givers
Through him, heal our hearts
And remove the rage from our hearts

Arabic text: وَاهْدِنَا بِهِ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ
Translation: Guide us through him to the truth in matters where there are differences, by Your permission

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
Translation: Indeed, You guide whom You will to a straight path
And help us through him against Your enemy and our enemy
O God of Truth, accept our prayer
O Allah, we complain to You

Arabic text: فَقْدَ نَبِيِّنَا صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: About the absence of our Prophet, Your blessings be upon him and his family
And the occultation of our guardian
And the abundance of our enemies
And the fewness of our numbers
And the severity of trials upon us
And the turning of time against us
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَعِنَّا عَلَى ذٰلِكَ بِفَتْحٍ مِنْكَ تُعَجِّلُهُ
Translation: And help us in this with a victory from You that You hasten
And with relief that You provide
And with aid that You strengthen
And with the authority of truth that You manifest
And with mercy from You that You encompass us with
And with well-being from You that You clothe us in
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
